content.subject: Manual matching dragging month‑end close
content.draft_text:
Hi Jon,
Your Q&A underscored that legacy rails don’t align with modern fintech workflows, especially when they force finance teams to chase data across disconnected platforms. That misalignment tends to stretch month‑end close because matching still happens manually across systems, pulling analysts away from higher‑impact analysis. We automate the cross‑system matching, feeding reconciled data into your ERP so the close can run on schedule without manual intervention. If you’re still reconciling by hand, how many hours does that add to each close, and what impact does that have on reporting cadence?
